Buzz & Waldog.name: Koko Adventure
Buzz & Waldog.summary: Koko Adventure is a Famicom platform game developed by Open Corp. in 1993. It is one of the few games for the Famicom that was developed in South Korea. This game was better well-known as its unreleased, American version known as Buzz & Waldog.

Nightmare on Elm Street, A - Son of a Hu.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street: Son of a Hundred Maniacs Demake
Nightmare on Elm Street, A - Son of a Hu.summary: Play as Freddy and terrorize teenagers in their sleep.

Over Horizon.name: Over Horizon
Over Horizon.summary: Over Horizon is a Shoot-'Em-Up game, developed by Pixel and published by Hot-B, which was released in Europe in 1991.

Terminator.name: The Terminator
Terminator.summary: The Terminator loosely follows the plot of the 1984 Arnold Schwarzenegger film. The main levels of the game consist of side-scrolling jumping and shooting action. In between levels are car chases where the Terminator attempts to run you down as you race to your next destination.
